pages.title: The Tier System
pages.text: $(mod_name) enforces a strict $(thing)tier-based progression$() system. Higher-tier items $(important)cannot be crafted$() on lower-tier workbenches.$(br2)Your crafting table tier must match or exceed the tier of the item you wish to make.$(br2)Additionally, recipes have $(thing)crafting time$() delays — be patient!

pages.title: Workbench Crafting
pages.text: Starting from the Flint Crafting Table$() — craft in the player's 2x2 inventory$(li2)$(item)Copper Crafting Table$() — craft on the Flint Crafting Table$(li2)$(item)Silver Crafting Table$() — craft on the Flint Crafting Table$(li2)$(item)Iron Crafting Table$() — craft on the Copper/Silver Crafting Table$(li2)$(item)Diamond Crafting Table$() — craft on the Iron Crafting Table$(li2)$(item)Netherite Crafting Table$() — craft on the Diamond Crafting Table$(li2)$(item)Vintage Crafting Table$() (use it to craft the Auto Crafting Table, skip crafting time!)

pages.title: Workbench Tiers
pages.text: $(li2)$(item)Vintage Crafting Table$() — craft on the Netherite Crafting Table, use it to craft the Auto Crafting Table, skip crafting time!$(li2)$(item)Auto Crafting Table$() — craft on the Iron Crafting Table, finally, you are no longer limited by crafting time.
Flint: knife + log. Copper: 9 Copper Ingots.
Silver → Iron: crafted on their previous tier.
Diamond: needs Ancient Metal. Netherite: final tier.

pages.title: Hold On a Moment
pages.text: An Iron Pickaxe cannot mine diamond ore veins — it's too hard. And crafting a Diamond Crafting Table requires diamonds.$(br2)You'll need to find a way to obtain a diamond through other means.

pages.title: Furnace Tiers
pages.text: Smelting also follows the tier system:$(li2)$(item)Clay Furnace$() — the most basic furnace, but cannot handle high-grade fuels$(li2)$(item)Cobblestone Furnace$() — can only be lit by coal$(li2)$(item)Obsidian Furnace$() — requires lava to power, essential for smelting Mithril ore$(li2)$(item)Netherrack Furnace$() — extremely high smelting speed, powered by Blaze Rods, can smelt Adamantium ore.

pages.title: Block Tiers & Mining Levels
pages.text: Blocks have hardness, and tools have mining levels. If your mining progress on a block remains at zero, try using a higher-tier tool to harvest it.

pages.title: Block Tiers & Mining Levels
pages.text: $(li2)At least use Flint tools to harvest logs.$(li2)At least use Flint tools (but very slow) or Copper tools to harvest stone.$(li2)At least use Copper Pickaxe/Hammer to harvest Iron ore.$(li2)At least use Iron Pickaxe/Hammer to harvest Obsidian.$(li2)At least use Mithril Pickaxe to harvest Diamond ore/Ancient Debris.$(li2)$(note)Experiment freely — if mining progress advances, the block can be harvested.$()

pages.title: Anvil Tiers
pages.text: Repairing equipment requires progressively better anvils, but now you don't need to spend XP to retrieve items — you only need sufficient tier:$(li2)$(item)Anvil$() — repairs up to Iron-tier equipment$(li2)$(item)Mithril Anvil$() — repairs up to Diamond or Mithril-tier equipment$(li2)$(item)Adamantium Anvil$() — infinite durability, supports all item repairs$(br)Each anvil repair has a $(thing)tier requirement$() — $(note)You can use the vanilla Anvil from Minecraft, or place it in the crafting grid at any time to convert it to the mod's custom anvil.

pages.title: Enchanting Table Tiers
pages.text: $(li2)$(item)Emerald Enchanting Table$() — Basic enchanting. Also used to craft $(item)Enchanted Golden Apples$().$(li2)$(item)Diamond Enchanting Table$() — Advanced enchanting. Enchant higher-level Sharpness swords to deal more damage to $(thing)Blazes$().$(br2)$(note)Higher-tier enchanting tables unlock more powerful enchantment combinations.$()

pages.text: Learn about advanced mechanics including enchantments, the food system, and combat.
